title: Aggregation, denominators and configuration history
question: How are progress totals aggregated and compared? This covers denominator fallback when takeoff is missing, zero and over-100 behaviour, weighting across stages, categories and locations, formula and unit changes, rounding, and what is audited when configuration changes.
context: Today stages are reported independently with no weighting. Project totals are summed at query time, denominators differ by view, and missing takeoff falls back to the measured value (PROG-REQ-001, -008, -025).
